judged_text: admin/groups_controller.rb update/create coerce a missing visible param to false, silently flipping group visibility on partial updates

record.issue_text: admin/groups_controller.rb update/create coerce a missing visible param to false, silently flipping group visibility on partial updates

adjudication.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#update the code unconditionally does `group.visible = params[:visible] == "true"`. If the request omits the `visible` parameter (a partial update), `params[:visible]` is nil, the expression evaluates to false, and a previously-visible group will be silently flipped to invisible on save. This is directly verifiable in the diff because alias_level is guarded with `if params[:alias_level].present?` while visible is not. (Create similarly defaults to false when visible is missing.)
